fact: Botswana's Minister of Basic Education told Parliament the ministry was in the process of procuring an EMIS, with P46.5 million budgeted for 2020/21 including computers and school LANs.

Statistics Botswana's brief says the 2022 Annual School Census was carried out by the Education Management Information Systems (EMIS) unit in the Ministry of Education and Skills Development, and the ministry's education statistics were published from it.
